description: Edge Delta group-by log monitor in the ALERT state, posted through the Slack legacy integration (incoming webhook) with a markdown notification template built from the documented monitor variables.
provenance: Edge Delta docs, Monitor Notifications: states ALERT / WARNING / OK / NO DATA / RECOVERED; the default notification carries the monitor name and a scope summary naming the affected group; templates use {{monitor.name}}, the monitor link https://app.edgedelta.com/monitors/{{monitor.id}}, {{value}}, {{comparator}}, {{alert_threshold}}, group-by attributes such as {{service.name}} and {{k8s.namespace.name}}, {{evaluated_from}} / {{evaluated_to}} and {{last_triggered_at}}, with {{#is_alert}} / {{#is_recovery}} blocks and bold state labels like '**ALERT**: ...'. Slack setup: an incoming-webhook app added as a Slack legacy integration and picked with @ in the Notifications section. The docs do not state how the time variables render; RFC 3339 is used here, and the parser accepts any format parse_time_text reads. Line layout is the template author's.
